gloss: infected person; patient with an infection

definitions.gloss: infected person; patient with an infection
definitions.explanation: A person who has contracted a contagious disease, especially a viral or bacterial infection. Standard term in medical and public health reporting.

examples.japanese: {感染者|かんせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The number of infected people is increasing.

examples.japanese: {感染者|かんせんしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{接触|せっしょく}→接触：12904_sesshoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please avoid contact with infected persons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧⟦{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}→感染者数：30152_kansenshasuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先週|せんしゅう}→先週：00752_senshuu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The number of new infections fell significantly from last week.

notes:
Became part of everyday vocabulary during the COVID-19 pandemic. The compound is ⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧ (infection) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧{感染者|かんせんしゃ}: new infections (newly reported cases)
- ⟦{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}→感染者数：30152_kansenshasuu⟧: number of infected people
- {感染者|かんせんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: an infection case appears
- ⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧⟦{接触|せっしょく}→接触：12904_sesshoku⟧⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: close contact (of an infected person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧: patient — broader; includes all illnesses, not just infectious
- {陽性者|ようせいしゃ}: a person who has tested positive
- {発症者|はっしょうしゃ}: a person showing symptoms (vs. asymptomatic carrier)
